description: This file defines an ErrorBoundary React component class implemented in TypeScript. It catches runtime exceptions in child components and renders a fallback UI with error details.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that acts as an error boundary to catch runtime errors in descendant components and display a user-friendly error message.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorBoundary component with default state.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Static method that updates state to indicate an error has occurred when caught.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Logs error information when an error is caught.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either the fallback UI when an error has occurred or the child components.
